**Constructing equivalences between fusion categories of quantum groups and of vertex operator algebras via quantum gauge groups**

*CLAUDIA PINZARI*

35 pp, 21 sections.

**Abstract.** This paper establishes connections between a problem posed by Doplicher and Roberts in the 1990s regarding construction of quantum gauge groups associated to the category of localized endomorphisms of conformal nets, and a problem by Huang con- cerning a direct proof of the Finkelberg equivalence theorem. We also unify the treatment of high dimensional algebraic QFT with the low dimensional case, resuming the study of Mack-Schomerus quantum symmetries, for which we previously proved a simplifying Hopf algebra property and studied the unitary structure of our global quantum gauge groups AW (g, q) of the WZW model. This program leads us to a solution of Huang’s problem in the setting of vertex operator algebras.
